one_line: This is a small septic-pumping and portable-toilet job, and it requires permits, a vacuum truck, and licensed drivers that we don't show having (a Riverside County Septic Pumper Permit, a California DMV Motor Carrier Permit, and a Class A/B license with air-brake endorsement), so it doesn't fit our trailer-rental business.
scope: CAL FIRE wants at least two portable toilets and two handwashing stations rented at Hemet-Ryan Air Attack Base (RAAB). The units must be serviced twice a week and moved as needed at no extra cost. The contractor must also pump the septic tanks at least three times a year (about 1,500 gallons per service, 13,500 gallons estimated, not guaranteed) with its own vacuum truck and/or trailer, respond on site within 48 hours, and haul waste to a certified disposal site with disposal records. The estimated term runs from January 1, 2027 (or CAL FIRE approval, whichever is later) through December 31, 2030, Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
fit: The place of performance (Hemet, CA) is in our home state. We are based in Marina del Rey, CA, and our work area is nationwide.
Portable sanitation is listed under our Facility Support & Utilities core competency.

Relevant past performance: the City and County of Denver restroom trailer contract (SC-00011558), which includes cleaning, pump-outs, waste disposal, and supplies, plus the USCG Lake Worth Inlet wastewater support (70Z02826FMIAM0008).
CAL FIRE is an emergency-responder agency, the kind of customer we already serve.
Our SBE/MBE status might qualify for the 5% California SB/MB preference, but only if we hold California DGS certification, which our documents don't show.
red_flags: HigherGov tags the set-aside as SDVOSBC. We have no SDVOSB certification, so if the tag is correct we can't bid as prime. The summary also mentions a DVBE incentive and an SB/MB preference, which would suggest open competition, so the tag may be wrong. Either way, it must be checked on Cal eProcure.

The contractor must hold a current Riverside County Septic Pumper Permit and an active California DMV Motor Carrier Permit, and keep a California Class A or B driver's license with air-brake endorsement. None of these is in our profile.
We need our own vacuum truck and/or trailer that meets state and federal DOT certification. Our fleet doesn't list one.
NAICS 562991 and PSC S299 are not in our NAICS, PSC, or GSA SIN lists.
Portable toilets and handwashing stations are standard units, not the restroom/shower trailers we rent. Our price list has no portable toilet or septic pumping rates.
The value is small: $12,000–$35,000 over about four years. That's hard to justify for twice-weekly service roughly 90 miles from our office, plus free relocations.
Quantities are not guaranteed, and CAL FIRE can change frequency and quantity.
Subcontracting is allowed only for subcontractors listed in the bid declaration. Even with a listed local pumper, it's unclear whether the prime itself must hold the permits.
Required insurance: $1M general liability, $1M employer's liability, workers' comp with waiver of subrogation, and $1M commercial auto, with the State named as additional insured.
The pack has no attachments (0). We haven't seen the solicitation, the rate sheet, or the bid declaration.
competition: The pack shows no past CAL FIRE awards under NAICS 562991, so the incumbent is unknown. Nearby benchmark: Clean Relief Portables won latrine vault and septic tank pumping in Idyllwild, CA (also in Riverside County) for $77,200 with 1 offer. That makes them a likely local competitor, but this is our inference, not a fact from the pack. Major Contracting Services wins most of the federal SDVOSB latrine work at Fort Polk and Fort Riley. Offer counts in the benchmarks range from 1 to 31 (GDH & Mrh Ventures, Brunswick, GA: 31 offers).
price_signal: CAL FIRE estimates $12,000–$35,000 for the full term, about $3,000–$9,000 per year. Comparable multi-year awards: Clean Relief Portables, Idyllwild, CA, latrine vault and septic pumping, $77,200 (PoP 2024-05-01 to 2028-04-30). GDH & Mrh Ventures, Brunswick, GA, portable toilet rental and maintenance, $37,140 (5 years, 31 offers). Upraise Construction, Kodiak, AK, portable toilet services, $80,205. Mbjsmart, Wellfleet, MA, wastewater tank pumping, $99,554 (5 years). Short jobs ran $2,070–$9,170. We have no internal price list rates for portable toilets, handwashing stations, or septic pumping.
must_have: Prime bidder licensed to do business in California. California or foreign corporations must be active and in good standing with the California Secretary of State; out-of-state bidders must provide good-standing documents (bid pack, HigherGov summary, Bidder Requirements)
Current Riverside County Septic Pumper Permit (bid pack, Bidder Requirements)
Active California DMV Motor Carrier Permit (bid pack, Bidder Requirements)
Valid California Class A or B driver's license with air-brake endorsement, kept for the whole agreement (bid pack, Bidder Requirements)
Vacuum truck and/or trailer meeting gross vehicle weight and state/federal DOT certification requirements (bid pack, Work Details)
Waste hauled to a certified disposal site, with disposal records provided to the county agency and CAL FIRE (bid pack, Work Details)
On-site response within 48 hours of a service call; toilets and handwashing stations serviced twice weekly; relocations at no additional cost (bid pack, Work Details)

Insurance: CGL $1M per occurrence; workers' comp with waiver of subrogation in favor of the State; employer's liability $1M; commercial auto $1M; State named as additional insured on GL and auto (bid pack, Bidder Requirements)
Any subcontractors listed in the bid declaration and holding their own required licenses and permits (bid pack, Bidder Requirements)
Completed rate sheet: 36 months of toilet and handwashing station rental, four pickups/drop-offs, and 13,500 gallons of septic pumping (bid pack, HigherGov summary; rate sheet not in pack)
Response by 2026-12-03 through Cal eProcure event 3CA08068 (bid pack, Opportunity)
